source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 23.2.3 (PDF 211), with a short note on the history of quinolones.

blocks.text: Fluoroquinolones synthetic (lab mein bani) antibacterial dawaen hain jo chloroquine (quinine) ki tayyari ke dauran zimni maadde (byproduct) ke taur par milin. Chloroquine aik synthetic dawa hai jo quinine ki banawat badal kar banayi gayi; quinine aik qudrati alkaloid hai jo South America ke Cinchona darakht ki chhaal mein hota hai. Fluoroquinolones George Lesher ne 1962 mein daryaft kin. Yeh bactericidal antibiotics ki qisam hai jo bacteria mein DNA replication (DNA ki nakal banna) rok kar infections ka ilaaj karti hai. In ke kuch sangeen magar kam hone wale (rare) side effects bhi hain: tendon (patthon ko haddi se jorne wali rassi) ka phatna, peripheral neuropathy (haath paon ki nason ka nuqsan), drug resistance aur dil ke masail.
